lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah he must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place.
The people will die from deadly diseases, and Jeremiah must not enter a house with a funeral meal.
The fathers forsook the LORD and followed other gods, so He will cast the people into an unknown land.
The LORD says the people will no longer speak of Egypt, and He will send many shepherds to catch them.
The LORD says He will first repay them seven times for their iniquity because they defiled His land with idols.
